papers.title: Super high strength of annealed Fe32Cr33Ni29Al3Ti3 manufactured by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) of high entropy alloys (HEAs) shows great potential in industry applications and annealing was always used as a post-processing method after SLM. A dual-phase (DP) Co-free HEA was manufactured by SLM and annealed at 900 °C in this work. The annealed HEA exhibited super high yield and tensile strengths (∼1224 and ∼1363 MPa, respectively), higher than those of the as-printed sample, primarily attributed to grain refinement and spinodal decomposition with FCC phase (rich in Ni/Al/Ti) and BCC phase (rich in Cr/Fe) decomposing into FCC (rich in Fe), B2 (rich in Cr, poor in Ni), and L1 2 (rich in Ni/Al/Ti, poor in Fe/Cr) during annealing. The annealed DP Co-free HEA exhibits notably superior strength to other Co-free HEAs or medium entropy alloys (MEAs) produced via SLM. Due to their affordability, Co-free HEAs show immense potential for widespread commercial use, and this study explores annealing in SLM to improve the mechanical properties of HEAs. The high-strength annealed DP Co-free HEA could be especially valuable for structural elements in construction applications. • Super high strength ever reported in SLM-processed Co-free HEAs or MEAS: The annealed Co-free HEA has a strength (yield strength ∼1224 and tensile strength ∼1363 MPa) higher than the as-printed sample (yield strength ∼857 and tensile strength ∼1207 MPa) and other reported SLM- processed Co-free HEAs or MEAs. Due to their affordability, Co-free HEAs show immense potential for widespread commercial use and this work shows its significance. • Unique elemental segregation: TEM results show that spinodal decomposition occurred with FCC phase (rich in Ni/Al/Ti) and BCC phase (rich in Cr/Fe) decomposing into FCC (rich in Fe), B2 (rich in Cr, poor in Ni), and L1 2 (rich in Ni/Al/Ti, poor in Fe/Cr) during annealing. This Co-free dual-phase HEA shows unique elemental segregation with element distribution that is quite different from other dual-phase HEAs, for example, AlCoCrFeNi2.1. • Strength increased after annealing at 900 °C: Different from other research with strength decreasing after annealing treatments at a temperature of 900 °C, the strength of the annealed Co-free dual-phase HEA (Fe32Cr33Ni29Al3Ti3) increased due to grain refinement and spinodal decomposition resulting in various strengthening mechanisms.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是SLM制备的钴-free高熵合金的退火强化，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高SLM制备钴-free高熵合金的强度，探索退火后处理效果。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Fe32Cr33Ni29Al3Ti3，900°C退火后表征微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 退火后合金屈服强度达1224 MPa，抗拉强度1363 MPa，优于同类材料。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和TEM微观分析验证性能提升和相分解机制。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical strength of Co-free high-entropy alloys fabricated by selective laser melting via post-process annealing.
summary_en.method: Fe32Cr33Ni29Al3Ti3 was fabricated by SLM and annealed at 900°C; microstructure and tensile properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Annealed alloy achieved a yield strength of ~1224 MPa and tensile strength of ~1363 MPa, outperforming other SLM-processed Co-free HEAs.
summary_en.validation: Tensile testing and TEM analysis confirmed strength enhancement due to grain refinement and spinodal decomposition.
